propositions: rebar lacks a first-class Bedrock provider; clients requiring Bedrock access currently must front it with an OpenAI-compatible gateway, forfeiting native prompt caching, structured output, and retry transport

prompt caching on Bedrock fails silently for unsupported models (e.g., us/global.claude-opus-4-5) with zero cache counters but full input billing, requiring a new warning predicate distinct from existing zeroed-usage guards

the temperature parameter is rejected (400 ValidationException) by some Bedrock models (e.g., claude-opus-4-7) but not others (e.g., claude-sonnet-4-6), necessitating per-model capability overrides keyed on exact model id rather than profile shape alone

rebar Pass-2 verify steps deliberately send temperature=0 for determinism; the direct-Anthropic path degrades gracefully via _drop_unsupported_sampling_settings, but BedrockConverseModel has no equivalent, causing hard failures on affected models

pydantic-ai's f184 story already ships BedrockModelSettings with the two cache keys (instructions, tool_definitions) selected by prompt_cache_style=='bedrock', but no builder exists to construct a Bedrock model, leaving that capability path unreachable in production

implementer requirements specify a separate module src/rebar/llm/bedrock_model.py to keep providers.py under its 300-LOC attested cap, a [bedrock] optional extra to exclude boto3 from default [agents] install, and blocking dependency on runner.py LOC headroom (task 2682)
